declaration.candidate_semantics: All at v28's share 0.75, residual stage, LIRF blends, outer weight 0.7 and floor. g_thirds and d_e24x32 are the two rounds' selections, repeated here so the rule chooses among everything on equal terms. c_e24x32_e32: the 32 e24 seeds and the 16 e32 seeds as three equal 16-seed tables (ctx16 dropped); c_e24x32_e32h: the 32 e24 seeds as one half, e32 the other; c_all64: all four 16-seed tables equally.

control.recipe: v28 = configs/adsb_ctx_v2.json pool_s75 (committee mix network 0.5 ens_ctx + 0.5 ens_ctx_e24 at share 0.75; v25's LIRF blends)
control.reproduction: the control must reproduce these (pool_s75's round-A development RMSE) to 1e-9 s on every recipe month before any candidate is read

external_data: adsb.lol globe_history (ODbL) via the committee's ADS-B tables and match tables
IEM weather and OurAirports runways via the timeline bundle

ens_ctx.ensemble: ens_ctx = per-fold seed mean over the 16 learners (tools/ensemble_adsb_full.py convention), every leaf checked against the declared variant, code, configuration and seed
ens_ctx.folds: seasonal (predicts 2025-01/07), forward (2025-11), refit (Jan-Nov; December leaf cache runs/december/learners/runs__adsb_ctx__ctx_s<seed>.parquet, ranking), refit12 (Jan-Dec; ranking), run in that order per seed by tools/ctx_chain.sh
ens_ctx.status: fitted and scored under adsb_ctx_v1 (its ensemble directory and December leaves unchanged)

ens_ctx_e24.ensemble: ens_ctx_e24 = per-fold seed mean over its 16 learners (tools/ensemble_adsb_full.py); December from the learners' January-November refit leaves
ens_ctx_e24.folds: seasonal (predicts 2025-01/07), forward (2025-11), refit (Jan-Nov; December leaf cache runs/december/learners/runs__adsb_ctx__ctx_s<seed>.parquet, ranking), refit12 (Jan-Dec; ranking), run in that order per seed by tools/ctx_chain.sh

ens_ctx_e24b.ensemble: ens_ctx_e24b = per-fold seed mean over its 16 learners (tools/ensemble_adsb_full.py); December from the learners' January-November refit leaves
ens_ctx_e24b.folds: seasonal (predicts 2025-01/07), forward (2025-11), refit (Jan-Nov; December leaf cache runs/december/learners/runs__adsb_ctx__ctx_s<seed>.parquet, ranking), refit12 (Jan-Dec; ranking), run in that order per seed by tools/ctx_chain.sh

ens_ctx_e32.ensemble: ens_ctx_e32 = per-fold seed mean over its 16 learners (tools/ensemble_adsb_full.py); December from the learners' January-November refit leaves
ens_ctx_e32.folds: seasonal (predicts 2025-01/07), forward (2025-11), refit (Jan-Nov; December leaf cache runs/december/learners/runs__adsb_ctx_gpu__ctx_e32_s<seed>.parquet, ranking), refit12 (Jan-Dec; ranking), by tools/run_adsb_ctx3.py --device cuda
ens_ctx_e32.hardware: four AWS g6e.2xlarge (one L40S each, us-east-2; SkyPilot clusters prc-ctx3a-d), float32 with TF32 matrix products, two lanes per GPU

declaration.purpose: Combined round required by configs/adsb_ctx_v3.json (round D, CPU, selected d_e24x32: -0.0875%) and configs/adsb_ctx_v4.json (32-epoch GPU round, selected g_thirds: -0.068%), which both change v28/v29's committee-mix network table: 'if both select, neither ships alone: a combined candidate is declared and scored first'. Declared after both selections and before any score of a combined table; no new fit.
declaration.selection: A candidate is eligible when: no recipe month is worse on ALL rows (ratio to the control <= 1.0); the mean ratio over the four recipe months is at least 0.02% below 1; and on every month where it changes a row the paired-day bootstrap 95% interval of the RMSE difference against the control lies below zero. Among eligible candidates choose the lowest mean ratio (ties by name); otherwise select nothing and keep the control. The rule of adsb_nn/nn2, unchanged.
declaration.ship: If a candidate is selected: its coverage-regime ship check (declared separately, the gate of configs/adsb_ctx_regime_check_v1.json) against pool_s75; ranking tables from the refit12 seed means; v29 rebuilt from its export detail must reproduce the uploaded v29 exactly; export, independent verification, audit; upload only with the user's approval.

rule: A candidate is eligible when: no recipe month is worse on ALL rows (ratio to the control <= 1.0); the mean ratio over the four recipe months is at least 0.02% below 1; and on every month where it changes a row the paired-day bootstrap 95% interval of the RMSE difference against the control lies below zero. Among eligible candidates choose the lowest mean ratio (ties by name); otherwise select nothing and keep the control. The rule of adsb_nn/nn2, unchanged.
